npc/clerk.doing: standing behind his desk, waiting for the runners the house sent

happening.text: the party hears what is happening to the ledger

happening.subject: npc/clerk
happening.text: Tobin tells them about the line he did not write, and gives them the key.

objectives.hint: He stands behind the long desk, facing you.
objectives.title: Talk to the clerk

barks: Forty bales in, thirty-one out. Those lines I wrote myself.
The ledger is kept by [[obfuscated|someone else]] at night.
Keep the key on you. Do not give it back to me, whatever I say.

npc/clerk.doing: back at his desk, adding up the day's sales and not looking at the chest

happening.text: the party locks the ledger away for the night

happening.subject: anchor/strongbox
happening.text: They turn the key on the ledger.

objectives.hint: Hold the Chest Key and use it on the chest under the window, behind the desk.
objectives.missing_item_hint: The lock needs its key. Hold the Chest Key in your hand.
objectives.title: Lock the [[bold|ledger]] in the chest

on_complete.text: The key turns twice. The ledger stays in the chest tonight.
